thread:
Mia (CS): Morning all — quick async standup for StratusPay renewal. TL;DR: customer is seeing webhook retries and higher token usage. What I did: followed up on logs, escalated to SRE, scheduled renewal call Wed 10am PT. Blockers: webhook retries causing duplicates, execs want a mitigation note. Today: need ETA on fix + a 1-paragraph exec summary we can send to customer. @Owen can you share status? :pray:

Owen (SRE): Reproduced issue in staging. Root cause looks like our connection pooling + transient DB lock on webhook handler. I have a small patch that switches to a pooled HTTP client and adds a short backoff. Running integration tests now. ETA for staging deploy ~40m, canary to prod ~2-3h after green.

Mia (CS): Great, thanks. Customer asked for a temporary workaround for the next 48h — any config we can recommend to reduce duplicates?

Owen (SRE): Temporary mitigation: increase retry interval on their side to 5s and enable idempotency key header if possible. On our side we can enable an inbound dedupe window of 6s for this customer route as a stopgap. I'll need ops signoff to flip that flag.

Julie (CS): I can draft the exec note once we have the phrasing. Proposal: 2 sentences describing mitigation + ETA to full fix.

Sam (Support): Adding logs we saw on their account this morning (redacted):
```
2024-06-02T08:12:03Z WARN webhook retry count=3 path=/pay/outcome idempotency=none
2024-06-02T08:12:04Z ERROR downstream timeout code=504
```
Also noticed average token usage spike on the /chat endpoint — could be related to customer-side prompt changes. I attached a short csv to the ticket.

Mia (CS): @Adam (AE) are you looped in with pricing talk if we recommend Dedicated for stability during renewal?

Adam (AE): Yep, I'm on it. If Dedicated reduces their risk we can fast-track a discounted first 3 months to help the renewal. I'll confirm with finance after we decide.

DevBot: deploy /staging service:webhooks @build-142 succeeded (2024-06-02 09:01 UTC)

Owen (SRE): Staging deploy looks good under smoke tests. Running load tests now. If green I'll promote to canary in ~30m and then ramp to prod.

Julie (CS): Drafted exec note (paste):
"StratusPay: We identified transient webhook retry duplicates caused by connection handling. Temporary mitigation: increase retry interval to 5s and enable idempotency headers. We will deploy a pooled client with a 6s server-side dedupe window; canary rolling now with expected full rollout within 4 hours. Scheduler: renewal call Wed 10am PT to review."

Mia (CS): That reads well — thank you. Please post the doc link and I'll send to the customer. Also I'll mention the Dedicated option and ping finance via Adam.

Sam (Support): FYI I updated the ticket with the CSV and annotated the spike windows.

Owen (SRE): Canary deployed to ~5% traffic, metrics look clean so far. No error-rate increase. Will ramp to 25% in 15m.

Mia (CS): Customer asked for an SLA workaround for the next 48h — can we guarantee the dedupe flag will hold?

Owen (SRE): Yes, the dedupe window is a config flag on our side tied to customer routing. Ops approved emergency flip. We can hold it for 72h if needed.

Adam (AE): I'll draft a short pricing note for Dedicated and share with Mia before EOD.

Julie (CS): Posting doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/stratuspay-exec-note-2024-06-02 (draft)

Mia (CS): Thanks everyone — I'll send the exec note to the customer now and mention the temporary dedupe + proposed Dedicated option. Blocking items: none pending if canary continues green. I'll follow up in-channel after the renewal call prep. :+1:

Owen (SRE): Canary fully ramped to 100% at 2024-06-02T10:45Z. No anomalous retries observed. Marking this incident mitigated. :tada:

Mia (CS): Closing loop — sending note and scheduling Wed call. Will update ticket with customer response. Thanks all!
